message.content:
Sure thing! To craft a trip that feels just right for you, could you let me know a bit more about your plans?

| What would help me tailor the itinerary? |
|------------------------------------------|
| • **Travel dates / flexibility** – When do you want to go, and how long can you stay? |
| • **Budget** – Rough range per person (flights, lodging, meals, activities). |
| • **Interests** – Museums, food, nightlife, day‑trips, shopping, nature, etc. |
| • **Travel style** – Luxury, mid‑range, budget, solo, couple, family, group. |
| • **Special needs** – Accessibility, dietary restrictions, language preferences. |

Once I have those details, I can put together a personalized schedule, suggest flights, hotels, must‑see sights, dining spots, and even a daily budget breakdown. If you’re happy with a general “classic Paris” outline, just let me know and I’ll dive straight in!
